Landscaping Services

Our landscaping services help homeowners plan gardens that suit their space and the way they use it. We offer garden design, installation and seasonal maintenance. Every project begins with a discussion of access, drainage, sunlight and the plants you want to grow. Our team explains the practical options before preparing a written scope for your approval.

Garden design and installation services

We prepare planting plans and show how pathways connect outdoor spaces. We select plants for the actual light and soil conditions, and discuss maintenance before installation. Homeowners can choose a phased project so essential work is completed first. We explain what the proposed work includes and what remains outside the agreed scope.

Our process and estimates

The process starts with an on-site consultation. A written estimate describes the design and installation scope, access requirements and proposed timeline. Pricing depends on site conditions, materials and the work selected. We discuss these choices before you decide whether to proceed. After installation we walk through the completed garden and explain how to care for new plants.

Project examples

Read our project case studies to understand the decisions behind completed gardens. The examples explain the original brief, the constraints and the solution. These are examples of work, not a promise that every garden needs the same approach.

How do I maintain a new garden?

Maintenance depends on the planting plan and season. Ask the team for the instructions that apply to your garden.
